description_for_human: Ask role-specific digital twins about the judgment behind past decisions, thresholds, dissent, and policy gates.
description_for_model: Use this plugin when the user asks about past decisions, reasoning, thresholds, dissent notes, or judgment of specific executive roles (CFO, CTO, CRO, CMO, LEGAL, CCO, CEO), or wants to start an Audio Executive Huddle. Do not use it for general document search or drafting.

functions.name: queryTwin
functions.description: Ask a role's digital twin (CFO, CTO, CRO, CMO, LEGAL, CCO, CEO) a question about past decisions, approval thresholds, counterfactual 'never-do' boundaries, and precedent.

functions.name: listRoles
functions.description: List every executive role that has a Wisdom Twin built, including document count, historical date range covered, and non-negotiable 'never-do' boundaries.

functions.name: getJudgment
functions.description: Drill into one specific DecisionEpisode judgment record by judgmentId to inspect verbatim evidence quotes, dissent notes, and threshold drift.

functions.name: startHuddle
functions.description: Start a multi-role Audio Executive Huddle session across selected executive role twins and return a live session join URL.
